title: EventHostPhotoUploadsStoragePath
description: Private staging object for a photo the event's host team is sharing with checked-in guests, at events/{eventId}/hostPhotoUploads/{photoId}/{fileName}. addEventHostPhoto re-encodes it without EXIF or location metadata into events/{eventId}/hostPhotos/{photoId}/ and deletes it.
x-storage-read: denied; the server reads the staged object
x-storage-write: event organizer owner or manager may create one JPEG or PNG original with uploaderUid metadata naming themselves once the event has started; reads, updates and deletes denied
